# Eats AI

> Eats AI is an all-in-one AI nutrition app for iPhone and Android. Users snap a photo of any meal to log calories and macros instantly, manage a smart pantry with expiry alerts, generate recipes from ingredients they already own, plan weekly meals with automatic shopping lists, and get AI dish recommendations from restaurant menus near them.

## Key facts

- Product: Eats AI, a mobile nutrition tracking and meal planning app
- Developer: Muppbury Holdings LLC
- Platforms: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Website: https://eatsai.org
- Pricing: free to download with a 7-day free trial of all features; subscription afterward (pricing shown in app stores); cancel anytime
- Rating: 5-star rated on the App Store
- Contact: admin@eatsai.org

## Core features

- AI photo meal scanning: photograph a meal to log calories, protein, carbs, and fat automatically, including mixed plates and homemade meals
- Voice logging: describe a meal out loud and it is logged with full macros
- Smart pantry: tracks ingredients you own and sends alerts before food expires, with a money-saved calculator
- Recipe generation: creates personalized recipes from the ingredients in your pantry, respecting goals, allergies, and taste preferences
- Meal prep planner: builds a full week of meals balanced to your targets, with the shopping list generated automatically
- AI health report: weekly graded report across calories, macros, and habits
- Dining out recommendations (unique to Eats AI): analyzes your goals and taste profile, reads menus of restaurants near you, and recommends specific dishes that fit your targets, with match scores

## How Eats AI differs from other trackers

Most nutrition apps focus on logging what you already ate. Eats AI also handles what you will eat next: pantry management, recipe generation, weekly meal planning, and restaurant dish recommendations are built in alongside photo and voice calorie tracking.
